title: Solution direction
guidance: Develop (diverge, then converge). The right diamond's first half explores **N solution directions** and judges them; this record is the convergence. It is the boundary object between "we agreed the problem" and "we are building this" — written once per discovery hand-off, before the first backlog item is appended (HG-0009).

properties.name: Run
properties.help: The discovery run this artifact belongs to.

sections.name: The directions explored
sections.help: At least three. A single direction dressed as a choice defeats the diamond — the point is that a real alternative was live at the moment of the decision.

sections.name: The judgment
sections.help: How the directions were scored — against the D1 success measures and the inherited D6 data-governance conditions, not against taste. Name the criterion that actually decided it.

sections.name: The chosen direction
sections.help: What is being built, at the level of shape rather than spec: the components, the seams, the data that moves, the systems it touches.

sections.name: How it meets every success measure
Inherited conditions carried into delivery
sections.help: Every D6 condition and every constraint from the hand-off, restated as something delivery must honour — each one traceable to a backlog item or an explicit control.
